crosscheck_results.X1_P041_vs_P049: PASS, and it vindicates rewriting the cross-check specification. Independent implementations on one specified seeded series. Level-crossing rate 8191.000000000000 Hz vs 8191.004095502048 Hz, relative difference 5.000002e-07. Mean fade duration 1.549737516786717e-05 s vs 1.5497375167867175e-05 s, relative difference 2.186262e-16. Tolerance was 2 percent. Both independently found 16382 down-crossings, 16382 complete fades, 1 censored, outage fraction 0.1269405. THE ENTIRE RESIDUAL IS ACCOUNTED FOR EXACTLY: P041 divides by N/fs (2.000000 s), P049 by (N-1)/fs (1.999999 s); 16382/2.000000 = 8191.000000 and 16382/1.999999 = 8191.004095502048, both reproduced by the coordinator. P049 also shipped a definitional-sensitivity table showing the single-sample-fade rule is the only choice that could move the answer more than 6.5 percent.
crosscheck_results.X2_P044_vs_P010: DISAGREE by a factor of 12.4506 - AND THE DEFECT IS IN THIS SESSION'S OWN SPECIFICATION, NOT IN EITHER PRODUCT. The spec never said whether the lognormal variate multiplies signal AMPLITUDE or signal POWER. P010's _ber_bpsk_cond is Q(I*sqrt(2*gamma)), irradiance on amplitude, SNR proportional to I squared - the standard intensity-modulation/direct-detection convention. P044 uses gamma_inst = (Eb/N0)*I, irradiance on power, SNR linear in I - the RF |h|^2 convention. Coordinator evaluated both by independent Gauss-Hermite quadrature: amplitude convention 7.518905101382814e-03 matches P010 to 2.3e-16 and P048's own reference to 5.1e-11; power convention 6.002225662486640e-04 matches P044's own reference to about 1e-10. EVERY PRODUCT IS INTERNALLY CORRECT. Convention-matched re-run P048 vs P010: 7.549000000e-03 against 7.5189051013828155e-03, z = +0.4917 on a 3-binomial-SE tolerance, PASS. NOTHING WAS RETUNED AND NO PRODUCT WAS CHANGED TO MAKE A NUMBER MATCH.
crosscheck_results.X3_P048: PASS. Soft-decision BER <= hard-decision BER at all seven stated Eb/N0 points on the same channel realisations, both decoders exhaustive ML over the same 16 codewords handed the same LLR array. Ratio rises 1.409 to 25.569 from 0 to 12 dB. At 12 dB, 693 blocks soft-right/hard-wrong against 5 the other way. No violation.

portfolio_convention_defect_NEEDS_OWNER: P044 models electrical SNR as LINEAR in irradiance while P010 and P048 model it as QUADRATIC (irradiance on amplitude). P044 documents its choice and lists it as convention C1 among five a disagreement could trace to, so it is disclosed not hidden, and it is defensible as a modelling choice. But P044's absolute BER and outage figures are NOT numerically comparable with the rest of the portfolio. Harmonising is an owner decision. An unattended session must not change a channel model at 07:00 with no time to re-validate the consequences, and this one did not.

honest_negatives_batch_05_DO_NOT_REMOVE.count: Seven, bringing the portfolio to sixteen. In FOUR products a non-learned method beat the learned one and was published as the result.
honest_negatives_batch_05_DO_NOT_REMOVE.P042: Learned GBR LOST to a non-learned analytic AR(1) MMSE predictor at all five feedback delays on lognormal (1.9759 vs 1.9737 bit/symbol at 1 ms through 1.6485 vs 1.6478 at 20 ms), never separated by 2 combined SEs. Structural: the lognormal channel is AR(1) in log-amplitude BY CONSTRUCTION so the MMSE predictor is exactly linear. Separately: the confidence GATE is worth +0.1537 to +0.2842 bit/symbol while the choice of predictor is worth 0.002-0.005, so the gate matters 30-140x more than the regression.
honest_negatives_batch_05_DO_NOT_REMOVE.P045: A TUNED FIXED SCHEDULE - two integers from a grid search on 40 tune seeds - beat the learned random forest in both regimes (+1.660 percent cost, z=2.27 long-burst; +3.031 percent, z=23.50 short-burst). The one-parameter escalating heuristic also beat it short-burst. The forest's own uncertainty explains why: at 63.3 percent of visited states it cannot distinguish its two best actions. Also: the agent's stated prior that bursts HURT selective repeat was contradicted by measurement - bursts HELP it - and the docs were rewritten to the measurement.
honest_negatives_batch_05_DO_NOT_REMOVE.P048: Learned LLR corrector LOST to the analytic posterior-aware LLR in all three mismatch regimes (1.121x, 1.078x, 1.060x). Published conclusion: marginalise over your CSI error, do not train a model. Plain scalar rescaling recovered only 17.0 percent of the excess when the estimate is biased high, and the tuner chose alpha=1.00 (no rescaling) in the under-estimating direction, for a measured structural reason: a positive scalar cannot move the decision's zero crossing.
honest_negatives_batch_05_DO_NOT_REMOVE.P049: The analytic level-crossing-rate predictor with a two-parameter Platt recalibration gave the BEST Brier score (0.0217557), ahead of logistic regression and both forest variants; the forest placed FOURTH OF SIX, at every horizon tested. The RAW analytic predictor has the best discrimination (AUC 0.8730) AND a NEGATIVE Brier skill (-0.0043), worse than doing nothing, because it over-forecasts by 2.2x. AUC alone would have called it the winner and Brier alone a failure; both published.
honest_negatives_batch_05_DO_NOT_REMOVE.P043: Closed forms WIN where their assumptions hold: at afterpulse probability <= 0.02 matched 0.0143 and composed 0.0136 against learned 0.0243, both within 50 percent of the counting-noise floor. NOTHING inverts the paralyzable upper branch (0.8336/0.8552/0.8399), pinned by test_nobody_inverts_the_paralyzable_upper_branch. A LABEL LEAK was found and removed (mean count per window encoded the answer); the Fano feature contributes nothing and the model is slightly better without it.
honest_negatives_batch_05_DO_NOT_REMOVE.P041: Learned predictor beats the honest state-blind empirical baseline by only 3.15 percent in Brier. The apparent 23 percent margin is over the exponential-exceedance closure and is almost entirely a calibration correction - README and MODEL_CARD label it misleading. Real evidence that state matters is AUC 0.6175 vs 0.5000. Uncertainty output weak and published as weak.
honest_negatives_batch_05_DO_NOT_REMOVE.P047: The classical white-noise timing-jitter formula OVER-PREDICTS BY 15.34x for early-late (3.09x Gardner, 1.00x Mueller-Muller) because detector self-noise is not white. The Rice/Gaussian cycle-slip estimate is wrong by SIX TO SIXTEEN ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE - functional form wrong, not scale - so NO fitted prefactor was offered.
honest_negatives_batch_05_DO_NOT_REMOVE.P046: Minimum spread is near-useless as a proxy for burst dispersion: Spearman rho 0.0343 across helical steps and -0.4857 across constructions at equal memory, i.e. it RANKS THEM BACKWARDS. At equal cost candidates differ 15.9x in dispersed burst. The S-random permutation, the one the literature recommends, came LAST of six at equal memory.
